svg.title: EMO Tracker data flow diagram, level 1
svg.text: Circles are processes, rectangles are external entities, and pairs of parallel lines are data stores.
Each process has its own row, so entities and data stores marked * are drawn more than once; each copy is the same entity or store.
Lookups of people's names (for example, a task owner's name on a report) are left out for readability.
